bolts.label: BOLTS (MOSTLY)
bolts.text: Mostly bolts, as promised. And one bolt so old it's turned to stone.

wires.label: WIRES (TANGLED)
wires.hint: The tangle inside is fierce. Steadier hands with wiring would help.
wires.text: A nest of cables, and in the middle of it a mixtape labelled SONGS FOR GOING FAST.

paint.label: PAINT (MOSTLY DRY)
paint.hint: Stuck shut with old paint. Someone with a feel for paint would know how to ease it.
paint.text: Tins of paint, and a jar labelled SWEAR JAR, full of loose pebs. Halloran swore a lot, apparently.

race.label: RACE STUFF
race.hint: Locked with a combination. The numbers are lap times. You'd need to have raced a bit.
race.text: Halloran raced? There's a pennant in here, CHAMPION, with the year scratched out.

mysteries.label: MYSTERIES
mysteries.hint: It hums faintly. A trained ear might work out what's rattling inside.
mysteries.text: A single marble of comet glass, glowing faintly. A note: 'Do not lose. Do not explain.'

do_not.label: DO NOT
do_not.hint: Bolted shut, from the inside somehow. A practiced mechanic could manage it.
do_not.text: A Halo drive, still in its wrapping, with a tag: 'For the Kettle, when they're ready.'

grommet.label: GROMMET'S
grommet.hint: Grommet sits on this one whenever you go near it.
grommet.text: Grommet's hoard: three bottle caps, a sock, and a washer engraved with a tiny horseshoe. Grommet lets you take the washer.

for_later.label: FOR LATER
for_later.hint: The label says FOR LATER. It isn't later yet.
for_later.text: A single envelope, addressed to you in Halloran's handwriting. It's on your tablet now.
